title: Better Librarians: Reforged
description: Revamps the librarian's trades, mostly adding new books and emerald prices

![PaperMC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/076651007d247110674d1c7e0ec94fa4e06504bc.png)

# This is _**Better Librarians: Reforged**_!

### What it does is...

It works really simply! Instead of librarians having random useless books, whenever a villager becomes a librarian, he can provide new enchantment book trades every time! The emerald prices are random, and can be set in ``` config.yml ``` ranging from  ``` default-min-emeralds ``` to ``` default-max-emeralds ```!


## ``` config.yml ```
Inside the config, you can tweak alot of things, but most importantly, you can add (or edit) other books to the trades!
Also, changes to config don't require server restart! Simply run ``` /betterlibrarian reload ```

```
  **book_name**:
    enabled: true
    enchantment: minecraft:**book_name**
    level: **level of the book**
    weight: **chance of the book appearing (1 by default)**
```
## ``` The List ```

By default, the list of books is:

```
- Protection IV
- Unbreaking III
- Mending
- Depth Strider III
- Sharpness V
- Sweeping Edge III
- Efficiency V
- Silk Touch
- Fortune III
- Feather Falling IV
- Respiration III
- Aqua Affinity
- Swift Sneak III
- Thorns III
- Soul Speed III
- Fire Aspect II
- Knockback II
- Density V
- Breach IV
- Riptide III
- Infinity
- Power V
```
but you can edit it!

## ``` Features ```
There are several features, that can be edited in ``` config.yml ```.

``` enabled ``` - Turns the plugin ON/OFF.

``` replace-enchanted-book-trades ``` - Same thing but toggles replacement of the enchanted books.

``` affect-existing-villagers ``` - Toggles if the plugin affects already trade-locked villagers.

``` avoid-duplicates-per-villager ``` - Toggles avoidment of the same books repeating in the villager's trades.

``` require-book-item ``` - Toggles the requirement of a book to be traded along with emeralds to get the enchanted book.
